assets.modificationNotes: Byte-identical already archived upstream example. Authored default main/root, original coordinates and transforms retained without source, argument, entrypoint, frame or fragment overrides. Existing original bounded JSCAD interpreter combines the five authored outputs into one editable native body; imported snapshot and colour losses are disclosed. No compiler/runtime change, model repair, simplification or placement adjustment. Not certified for manufacturing or physics. Import warnings: JSCAD conversion is an evaluated snapshot; keep the original source for parametric edits. Multiple JSCAD outputs are combined into one rigid body in the code editor. Only whole-output JSCAD colours are retained in conversion metadata; face colours are not converted.

conversion.unitAssumption: The source has no explicit physical units. Curator interprets model units as millimetres and Z up; original coordinates are preserved.
